openFindings.description: Host helpers retain user-level read/access capabilities; full filesystem/registry/credential/network capability confinement remains incomplete. The low-integrity probe explicitly observes ordinary-file read access.
Independent security audit, sustained fuzzing, second-user login tests and a clean Windows/version matrix remain pending.
Current automatic templates refuse the SDK-linked Winsock fixture before execution. This is not an end-to-end socket-compatibility pass.
Clean/no-WHP host acceptance, CA-backed Authenticode and production signing-key operations remain open.
